review_reason: Short title of the General Obligations Law; changes no rule's reach.

heading: Construction of act of reconsolidation
review_reason: The 1963 General Obligations Law is a continuation of the provisions it replaced; historical codification.

heading: Definition
review_reason: Defines 'infant' and 'minor' as under 18 for the GOL; the age of capacity is proposed at GOL 3-101 (NY:GOL-3-101-age-of-capacity) and suits against infants are stated (NY:CPLR-1203-1015-5208-parties).

heading: Provisions excluding application of certain sections to matters previous to dates of their original enactment
review_reason: Start dates (1928 to 1974) of GOL sections; every tenancy in this chain arose after them, so they change nothing.

heading: When contracts may not be disaffirmed on ground of infancy
review_reason: Decides capacity: a lease signed at 18 or older cannot be disaffirmed for infancy; no rule states the tenant's age of capacity.

heading: Obligations of certain minors for hospital, medical and surgical treatment and care
review_reason: Married minors' medical obligations; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Contracts pursuant to the "Servicemen's Readjustment Act of 1944" as amended
review_reason: Capacity of minor veterans for GI Bill loans; not a lease.

heading: Certain contracts of parents or guardians respecting employment of infants not enforceable unless approved
review_reason: Parents' liability on infants' employment contracts; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Payment of wages to minor
review_reason: Payment of wages to minors; outside the chain.

heading: Negligence of parent or other custodian not imputed to infant
review_reason: Parent's negligence not imputed to an infant in personal-injury actions; outside the chain.

heading: Liability of parents and legal guardians having custody of an infant for certain damages caused by such infant
review_reason: Gives the landlord a claim, capped at $5,000, against the parent of a child aged 10 to 17 who wilfully damaged the unit, which matters when the parent is not the tenant (a guest's or occupant's child).

heading: Powers of married woman
review_reason: Confirms a married woman contracts, is liable and is sued as if unmarried; no settlement step differs by marital status, and equal treatment is stated (NY:EXEC-296(5)(a)(2)-terms).

heading: Contracts in contemplation of marriage
review_reason: Prenuptial contracts survive marriage; outside the chain.

heading: Contract of married woman not to bind husband
review_reason: Decides who may be pursued: a married tenant's lease does not bind the non-signing spouse or the spouse's property.

heading: Liability of husband for antenuptial debts
review_reason: Liability for a spouse's antenuptial debts to the extent of property acquired by antenuptial contract; a move-out balance is not collected on that basis.

heading: Husband and wife may convey to each other or make partition
review_reason: Spouses may convey property to each other; outside the chain.

heading: Marriage relationship not to affect construction of instruments and transactions involving personal property
review_reason: Marriage does not change joint ownership of personal property; the co-tenant refund payee rule is stated (NY:ADJ-cotenants-payee).

heading: Right of action by or against married woman, and by husband or wife against the other, for torts
review_reason: Married persons' tort actions and liability; a spouse is liable only for its own torts, and the balance is a lease claim.

heading: Married woman's right of action for wages
review_reason: Married woman's right to her own wages; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Effect of death upon power of attorney given by persons engaged in certain occupations
review_reason: Decides whether a refund paid, or a surrender or release signed, by a servicemember-tenant's attorney-in-fact after the tenant's unknown death binds the estate.

heading: Required information and statement in applications for licenses to conduct occupations
review_reason: Child-support certification in occupational licence applications; it concerns the licensing agency's process, not the settlement.

heading: Definitions of terms as used in certain sections
review_reason: Defines 'interest in real property' for GOL 5-703 to include chattel interests (leases) and 'conveyance' to include a writing surrendering an interest; the stated early-termination rule depends on it.

heading: Certain employment contracts void
review_reason: Void anti-union employment contracts; outside the chain.

heading: Contracts for the creation and use of digital replicas
review_reason: Void digital-replica clauses in performance contracts; outside the chain.

heading: Certain agreements between husband and wife void
review_reason: Void spousal agreements to dissolve marriage or waive support; outside the chain.

heading: Agreements exempting lessors from liability for negligence void and unenforceable
review_reason: A lease clause exempting the landlord from its own negligence is void, so it cannot shift to the tenant a move-out charge for damage the landlord or its agents negligently caused, nor bar the tenant's offset for its own losses.

heading: Agreements exempting caterers and catering establishments from liability for negligence void and unenforceable
review_reason: Void negligence waivers for caterers; outside the chain.

heading: Agreements exempting owners and contractors from liability for negligence void and unenforceable
review_reason: Voids indemnity for a promisee's own negligence in construction and repair contracts; it governs the landlord's contractors, not a charge to the tenant (NY:GOL-5-321-exculpation-void governs the lease).

heading: Contents of certain construction contracts
review_reason: Owner identification in building construction contracts; a contracting formality between owner and contractor, not a tenant charge or step.

heading: Payment bonds to be filed
review_reason: Filing of payment bonds on private improvements over $100,000; outside the chain.

heading: Agreements exempting building service or maintenance contractors from liability for negligence void and unenforceable
review_reason: Voids negligence exemptions for building service and maintenance contractors in their contracts; it binds no charge or credit between landlord and tenant.

heading: Agreements by owners, contractors, subcontractors or suppliers to indemnify architects, engineers and surveyors from liability caused by ...
review_reason: Void indemnities of architects and engineers for design defects; outside the chain.

heading: Garages and parking places
review_reason: Garage operators may not exempt themselves from negligence liability; a parking operator's rule, while a residential lease's exculpation clause is governed by GOL 5-321 (proposed NY:GOL-5-321-exculpation-void).

heading: Agreements exempting pools, gymnasiums, places of public amusement or recreation and similar establishments from liability for negligence...
review_reason: Void negligence waivers by pools, gyms and places of recreation that charge for use; it governs liability for injury, not any charge, deposit or step in settling a tenancy.

heading: Consumers' right to recover attorney's fees in actions arising out of consumer contracts
review_reason: Reciprocal attorney's fees in consumer contracts of creditors, sellers and personal-property lessors; a residential real-property lease is governed by RPL 234 (NY:RPL-234) and RPL 234-a.

heading: Processing fee by holder of dishonored check
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Certain covenants and restrictions in conveyances and other agreements affecting real property void as against public policy
review_reason: Voids racially restrictive covenants in instruments affecting real property; the settlement's equal-treatment duty is stated (NY:EXEC-296(5)(a)(2)-terms) and no settlement term turns on such a covenant.

heading: Unsolicited and voluntarily sent merchandise deemed unconditional gift
review_reason: Unsolicited merchandise is a gift; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Validity of oil, gas or mineral land leases
review_reason: Oil, gas and mineral lease terms; outside the chain.

heading: Option or right to acquire interest in property
review_reason: Enforceability of equity options granted to large mortgage lenders; outside the chain.

heading: Limitation of reimbursement and subrogation claims in personal injury and wrongful death actions
review_reason: Insurer subrogation limits in personal-injury settlements; outside the chain.

heading: Nondisclosure agreements
review_reason: Subdivision 3 is not limited to employers: a release of any claim whose facts involve unlawful discrimination is unenforceable if it carries NDA penalties or a no-discrimination disclaimer; this governs a move-out settlement with a tenant alleging discrimination.

heading: Agreements requiring contractees to waive their rights in relation to expressing certain opinions about contractors void and unenforceable
review_reason: Bars non-disparagement waivers in contracts for the sale or lease of consumer goods or services; a residential lease of real property and its settlement are neither.

heading: Rate of interest
review_reason: No rule states the usury cap. A payment plan on a move-out balance in which the landlord agrees to wait in return for interest is a forbearance; its interest is capped by 5-501 and Banking Law 14-a.

heading: Usurious contracts void
review_reason: Consequence of a usurious forbearance agreement on a balance: the agreement is void and its enforcement is enjoined.

heading: Recovery of excess
review_reason: Tenant's recovery of usurious interest paid under a forbearance on the balance.

heading: Borrower bringing an action need not offer to repay
review_reason: Branch of the usury consequence: a tenant suing over a usurious payment plan need not first repay or tender anything.

heading: Transfer of cause of action for usury
review_reason: Transfer of a usury cause of action tied to security on specific property; no payment plan in this chain carries such security.

heading: Return of excess a bar to further penalties
review_reason: Cure for a usurious forbearance on a balance: returning the excess discharges further forfeiture or penalty.

heading: Corporations prohibited from interposing defense of usury
review_reason: Branch of the usury rules for a company tenant: a corporation cannot plead civil usury against a forbearance on its balance, only criminal usury.

heading: Interest permitted on advances on collateral security
review_reason: Interest on demand advances of $5,000 or more on documents of title or securities; not a tenant balance.

heading: Taking security upon certain property for usurious loans
review_reason: Misdemeanor of taking household goods as security for a usurious loan; the landlord takes no such security and may not hold belongings for rent (NY:COMMONLAW-belongings-owner-keeps).

heading: Interest charged by a registered broker or dealer for carrying debit balances
review_reason: Interest on securities brokers' debit balances; outside the chain.

heading: Interest on secured loans or forbearances
review_reason: Usury exemption for secured corporate business loans of $100,000 or more; no payment plan on a tenant balance is such a loan.

heading: Enforceability of compound interest
review_reason: Compound interest rules for loans and financing over $250,000; no tenant balance or payment plan in this chain is such a financing.

heading: Brokerage on loans
review_reason: Loan brokerage fees; no loan is brokered in the settlement.

heading: Interest on deposits in escrow with mortgage investing institutions
review_reason: Interest on mortgage escrow accounts of owner-occupied homes and co-ops; not a tenant deposit.

heading: Interest on insurance draft deposits in escrow with mortgage investing institutions
review_reason: Interest on insurance drafts held in mortgage escrow for owner-occupied homes; a mortgagee's escrow, not a tenant's security deposit.

review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Conveyances and contracts concerning real property required to be in writing
