review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Execution and acknowledgment of assumption of mortgage debt by grantee of mortgaged real property
review_reason: A grantee is liable on an existing mortgage only if it assumes it in writing; between owner and lender, not the tenancy account.

heading: Certain provisions of leases of personal property inoperative unless notice thereof given to lessee
review_reason: Automatic renewal in leases of personal property; the real-property counterpart is stated (NY:GOL-5-905).

heading: Automatic renewal provision of contract for service, maintenance or repair unenforceable by contractor unless notice thereof given to rec...
review_reason: Automatic renewal of contracts for service, maintenance or repair; a residential lease is governed by GOL 5-905 (stated), and no settlement step turns on a service contract's renewal.

heading: Certain provisions of leases to be inoperative unless express notice thereof is given to tenant
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Agreements relating to securities
review_reason: Agreements to transfer securities not void for want of consideration; outside the chain.

heading: Written agreement for modification or discharge
review_reason: Early termination in writing is stated (NY:GOL-5-703-15-301-early-termination); 5-1103 adds that a written modification or discharge of the lease or the balance needs no consideration if signed by the party to be charged or its agent.

heading: Written promise expressing past consideration
review_reason: Makes a written promise on past consideration enforceable; the balance is already owed under the lease, so a later promise matters only as an acknowledgment, stated by NY:GOL-17-101-acknowledgment.

heading: Written assignment
review_reason: A written, signed assignment of the balance (for example to an affiliate or collector) transfers it irrevocably without consideration; this fixes who holds the claim.

heading: Written irrevocable offer
review_reason: A written settlement offer stated to be irrevocable for a period cannot be withdrawn during it, which fixes how long a landlord's (or tenant's) written offer on the balance stays open.

heading: Execution by agent in real property transactions
review_reason: The written-authority requirement for an agent's surrender of a lease over one year is stated through GOL 5-703; 5-1111 extends it to an agent's written modification, discharge or assignment of such a lease.

heading: Written or published promise or reward
review_reason: Written promises of a reward for lost property; not a settlement matter.

heading: Promises and warranties in conveyances made without consideration
review_reason: Grantor's promises in a recordable deed binding without consideration; the chain involves no deed.

heading: How interest calculated
review_reason: The lease-rate interest rule (NY:CASE-NML-contract-rate) is stated; 5-1301 adds that a rate stated without a period is a yearly rate.

heading: Uniform vendor and purchaser risk act
review_reason: Risk of loss between vendor and purchaser in a contract of sale of realty; a building sale's effect on the tenant's deposit is governed by the stated GOL 7-105 and 7-108(2) rules, and this allocates risk only between seller and buyer.

heading: Application and definitions
review_reason: Scope and definitions of the POA title; its operative effects on the settlement are carried in the rules proposed at GOL 5-1501B, 5-1502A, 5-1502H, 5-1507, 5-1511 and 5-1512.

heading: Power of attorney not affected by incapacity
review_reason: Decides whether the landlord may deal with, and pay the refund to, the tenant's agent after the tenant becomes incapacitated.

heading: Creation of a valid power of attorney
review_reason: Decides whether a New York power of attorney presented by a tenant's agent (to receive the refund, dispute charges or settle) is valid and in effect.

heading: Powers of attorney excluded from this title
review_reason: The owner's grant of authority to a licensed broker-manager over leases and management is outside the POA title, so the management agreement need not meet POA formalities; this decides how a manager's written authority (NY:GOL-5-1111-agent-written-authority) is shown.

heading: Construction--real estate transactions
review_reason: Decides what an agent under a statutory short-form 'real estate transactions' grant may do in the settlement: give notice and surrender the lease, and demand and receive the deposit refund, and settle claims arising from the lease.

heading: Construction--chattel and goods transactions
review_reason: Construction of a statutory short-form power over chattels and goods; the refund and deposit claim fall under claims and litigation (proposed at GOL 5-1502H), not this grant.

heading: Construction--bond, share and commodity transactions
review_reason: Agent authority over bonds, shares and commodities; no settlement act involves them.

heading: Construction--banking transactions
review_reason: Agent authority over bank accounts; the landlord's dealing with a tenant's agent over the refund turns on the real-estate and claims grants (proposed at GOL 5-1502A and 5-1502H).

heading: Construction--business operating transactions
review_reason: Agent authority over business operations; no settlement act turns on it.

heading: Construction--insurance transactions
review_reason: Agent authority over insurance; no settlement act turns on it.

heading: Construction--estate transactions
review_reason: Agent authority over estate transactions of which the principal is a beneficiary; the refund payee on a tenant's own death is stated (NY:ADJ-tenant-death-payee).

heading: Construction--claims and litigation
review_reason: Decides what a tenant's agent under a statutory short-form 'claims and litigation' grant may do in the settlement: dispute, settle, release, receive and endorse the refund.

heading: Construction--personal and family maintenance
review_reason: Agent authority to provide living quarters and family maintenance; lease surrender, refund receipt and claims settlement are governed by the grants proposed at GOL 5-1502A and 5-1502H.

heading: Construction--benefits from governmental programs or civil or military service
review_reason: Agent authority over government and military benefits; no settlement act turns on it.

heading: Construction--matters related to health care
review_reason: Agent authority over health-care matters; no settlement act turns on it.

heading: Construction--retirement benefit transactions
review_reason: Statutory power of attorney authority over retirement benefits; outside the chain.

heading: Construction--tax matters
review_reason: Agent authority over tax matters; no settlement act turns on it.

heading: Construction--all other matters
review_reason: 'All other matters' grant; lease and refund matters fall under the specific grants proposed at GOL 5-1502A and 5-1502H.

heading: Modifications of the statutory short form power of attorney
review_reason: Modifications of the statutory short form; whether a given power covers the settlement is read from its grants (proposed at GOL 5-1502A and 5-1502H).

heading: Acceptance of and reliance upon acknowledged and witnessed statutory short form power of attorney
review_reason: Governs the landlord's handling of a statutory short-form POA presented to receive the refund or settle: it must honor or reject in writing within ten business days, may not refuse without reasonable cause, and is held harmless when it relies in good faith.

heading: Standard of care
review_reason: An agent's duties to its own principal; a landlord dealing with the agent is protected by the reliance rules, not this section.

heading: Compensation
review_reason: An agent's compensation from the principal; no settlement step turns on it.

heading: Signature of agent
review_reason: Decides whether the landlord is protected in accepting an agent's signature on a settlement document.

heading: Co-agents and successor agents
review_reason: Decides whether one of several agents named in the tenant's power may alone receive the refund or settle.

heading: Appointment of monitor
review_reason: A principal's appointment of a monitor over the agent; no landlord act turns on it.

heading: Special proceedings
review_reason: Special proceedings about a power of attorney; a landlord may seek to compel acceptance or construction there, but no settlement amount, date or payee turns on it.

heading: Termination or revocation of power of attorney
review_reason: Decides whether a refund paid to, or a release taken from, the tenant's agent binds after the power ended: it does if the landlord acted in good faith without actual notice of the termination.

heading: Powers of attorney executed in other jurisdictions
review_reason: A power of attorney executed elsewhere, valid where made, is valid in New York; this decides whether an out-of-state tenant's agent may act in the settlement.

heading: Statutory short form power of attorney
review_reason: The statutory short-form POA text; what the form's grants authorize in the settlement, and its validity and acceptance, are proposed at GOL 5-1501B, 5-1502A, 5-1502H and 5-1504.

heading: Money deposited or advanced for use or rental of personal property
review_reason: Governs deposits on rentals of personal property; a dwelling deposit is governed by GOL 7-103 and 7-108.

heading: Money deposited or advanced for use or rental of real property
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Landlord failing to turn over deposits made by tenants or licensees and to notify tenants or licensees thereof in certain cases
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Money deposited or advanced for certain installations
review_reason: Deposits on contracts for private sewer connections; not a tenant deposit.

heading: Deposits made by tenants of rent stabilized dwelling units
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Deposits made by tenants of non-rent stabilized dwelling units
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Commencement of a proceeding or action by the attorney general to compel compliance
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Compensation for injury or damage caused by the intoxication of a person under the age of twenty-one years
review_reason: Civil action against those who furnish alcohol to under-21s; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Compensation for injury caused by the illegal sale of intoxicating liquor
review_reason: Dram-shop civil action; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Liability of utilities for compensation for damages caused by interfering with, or delaying the progress of work under state public const...
review_reason: Utility liability to state contractors for delaying public works; outside the chain.

heading: Compensation for injury caused by the illegal sale of controlled substances
review_reason: Civil action against unlawful sellers of controlled substances; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Additional liability of drawer
review_reason: The returned-check fee cap is stated (NY:RPL-238-a(2-a)); 11-104 adds that a residential rent check carries no statutory bounced-check damages, and sets the conditions for them on any other check.

heading: Larceny in mercantile establishments
review_reason: Civil liability for shoplifting from mercantile establishments; a rental building is not a mercantile establishment.

heading: Compensation for injury or death to police officers and firefighters or their estates
review_reason: Police officers' and firefighters' injury claims against negligent persons; not a settlement claim between landlord and tenant.

heading: Compensation for harm to a guide, hearing or service dog
review_reason: Damages for injury to a guide or service dog by another dog; not a tenancy settlement.

heading: Transfer of claims
review_reason: Champerty is stated (NY:JUD-489-champerty) but not the base rule that the lease balance, and the tenant's deposit claim, are freely transferable and enforceable by the transferee in its own name subject to prior defenses.

heading: Transfer of judgment for sum of money
review_reason: A money judgment against the former tenant may be assigned, which changes who may enforce it.

heading: Effect of transfer of claim or demand
review_reason: Its effect (transferee enforces in its own name, subject to defenses before notice) is proposed jointly with 13-101 as NY:GOL-13-101-105-balance-transfer; champerty limits are stated.

heading: Claims or demands transferred with bond unless reserved
review_reason: Claims pass with transferred bonds; outside the chain (assignment of a lease balance is governed by the stated champerty rule).

heading: Definition of "transfer
review_reason: 'Transfer' in GOL 13-101 to 13-107 includes sale, assignment and gift; its reach is carried in the rule proposed at GOL 13-101 (NY:GOL-13-101-105-balance-transfer).

heading: Definitions
reason: DEFINITIONS: definition section in a unit that has a stated rule
review_reason: Defines the reach of GOL title 15 (releases and co-obligors), on which NY:GOL-15-104-105-cotenant-release depends: it covers contract obligations only, not tort liability.

heading: Co-obligor not a party
review_reason: Release of one co-tenant is stated (NY:GOL-15-104-105-cotenant-release); 15-102 adds that a judgment against one or some co-tenants does not discharge a co-tenant or guarantor who was not a party.

heading: Consideration to be credited to co-obligor
review_reason: Release of a co-tenant is stated; 15-103 adds that any payment or value received from one co-tenant is credited on the obligation of every co-tenant, unless the payer stood as the others' surety.

heading: Discharge of one obligor, with reservations
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Discharge of one obligor, without reservation
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Death of joint obligor
review_reason: Tenant death is stated for a sole or last surviving tenant (NY:ADJ-tenant-death-payee); 15-106 adds that when one of several co-tenants dies, the estate stays jointly and severally liable with the survivors.

heading: Release of partner
review_reason: Release of a partner from partnership liability; applies to a partnership tenant as the ordinary release rule already stated (NY:GOL-15-104-105-cotenant-release) and changes no settlement amount for a residential tenant.

heading: Release or covenant not to sue
review_reason: Releases among joint tortfeasors and contribution under CPLR article 14; the balance is a contract claim under the lease (GOL 15-101), and no settlement step turns on tortfeasor contribution.

heading: Uniformity of interpretation
review_reason: Uniform interpretation of the joint-obligations title; a construction canon that changes no outcome of the stated co-obligor release and payment rules.

heading: Inconsistent laws repealed
review_reason: Repeal clause of GOL title 15; it states no operative rule.

heading: When written agreement or other instrument cannot be changed by oral executory agreement, or discharged or terminated by oral executory a...
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Release in writing without consideration or seal
review_reason: Decides the write-off branch: a written release of the balance (or of the deposit claim) binds without consideration.

heading: Forfeiture and cancellation of oil, gas or mineral land leases
review_reason: Cancellation of record of expired oil, gas and mineral leases; outside the chain.

heading: Executory accord
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Offer of accord followed by tender
review_reason: Full-payment checks are stated (NY:UCC-1-308-full-payment-check); 15-503 adds that a written signed offer to accept a stated performance in satisfaction, once tendered before revocation, discharges the claim even if the tender is refused.

heading: Surety not discharged by failure or refusal by creditor to sue principal debtor
review_reason: The guaranty writing rule is stated; 15-701 adds that the landlord's refusal to sue the tenant after the guarantor's demand does not discharge the guarantor unless they agreed otherwise in writing.

heading: Surety disclosure
review_reason: Co-signer disclosure in consumer credit transactions; a lease guaranty is not consumer credit (NY:ADJ-lease-balance-not-consumer-credit), and the guaranty writing rule is stated (NY:GOL-5-701(a)(2)-guaranty).

heading: Acknowledgment or new promise must be in writing
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Agreements waiving the statute of limitation
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Promises and waivers affecting the time limited for action to foreclose a mortgage
review_reason: Waivers and promises extending the time to foreclose a mortgage; mortgage enforcement.

heading: Effect of part payment on time limited for foreclosure of a mortgage
review_reason: Part payment extending the time to foreclose a mortgage; mortgage enforcement.

heading: Examination and admission of attorneys
review_reason: Bar examination and admission of attorneys; which counsel an entity owner must use is stated (NY:CPLR-321-JUD-495-appearance), and admission procedure adds no step.

heading: Applications for special arrangements
review_reason: Special arrangements for bar examinees; outside the chain.

heading: Compensation of state board of law examiners
review_reason: Compensation of the Board of Law Examiners; outside the chain.

heading: Annual account by state board of law examiners
review_reason: Board of Law Examiners' annual account; outside the chain.

heading: Times and places of examinations
review_reason: Times and places of bar examinations; outside the chain.

heading: Certification by state board of successful candidates
review_reason: Certification of successful bar candidates; outside the chain.

heading: Fee for examinations and for credential review for admission on motion
review_reason: Bar examination fees and refunds; outside the chain.

heading: Attorney's oath of office
review_reason: Attorney's oath of office on admission; outside the chain.

heading: Registration of attorneys
review_reason: Lists of newly admitted attorneys sent to the Court of Appeals; outside the chain.

heading: Official registration of attorneys to be kept by the chief administrator of the courts
review_reason: Official register of attorneys kept by the Chief Administrator; a public record, not a step for the landlord or collector.

heading: Biennial registration of attorneys
review_reason: Biennial attorney registration and fee; binds attorneys, not the owner hiring one.

heading: Clients' security fund of the state of New York
review_reason: Lawyers' Fund for Client Protection reimburses losses from attorney dishonesty; a remedy against the attorney, not a step in the settlement.

heading: Continuance where attorney is member of legislature
review_reason: Continuances when counsel is a legislator in session; in-suit mechanics.

heading: Attorneys having offices in this state may reside in adjoining state
review_reason: Attorneys with a New York office may live in an adjoining state; outside the chain.

heading: Attorney who is judge's partner or clerk prohibited from practicing before him or in his court
review_reason: A judge's partner or clerk may not practice before the judge; outside the chain.

heading: Attorney who is surrogate's parent or child prohibited from practicing berfore him
review_reason: A surrogate's parent or child barred where the surrogate's partner is; outside the chain.

heading: Constables, coroners, criers and attendants prohibited from practicing during term of office
review_reason: Court officers and sheriffs may not practice law while in office; outside the chain.

heading: Compensation of attorney or counsellor
review_reason: Attorney compensation is by agreement, with court control of contingency fees on infants' claims; whether the landlord may recover legal fees from the tenant is decided by the stated RPL 234 and 234-a rules.

heading: Contingent fees for attorneys in claims or actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice
review_reason: Contingent-fee caps in medical malpractice cases; not a claim in the chain.

heading: Attorney retainer statements
review_reason: Sharing attorney retainer statements with social services; not a step in the chain.

heading: Attorney's lien in action, special or other proceeding
review_reason: An attorney who appears for the former tenant (or the landlord) has a lien on the claim and on any settlement or judgment proceeds in whatever hands they come, unaffected by a settlement between the parties; decides to whom a deposit settlement is paid when the tenant has counsel.

heading: Notice of lien
review_reason: An attorney who serves a written notice of lien before suit (for example with a tenant's deposit demand) has a lien from that notice on any settlement or recovery, unaffected by a later direct settlement; decides to whom a pre-suit deposit settlement is paid.

heading: Action against attorney for lending his name in suits and against person using name
review_reason: An attorney who knowingly lets a non-partner prosecute an action in the attorney's name, and the person who does so, each forfeit $50 to the other side; bars Handoff or a manager from running suits in a lawyer's name.

heading: Action for unlawful practice of the law
review_reason: Attorney General actions for unauthorized practice of law; an enforcement remedy for the State. The prohibitions that bind Handoff are stated (NY:CPLR-321-JUD-495-appearance) and proposed (NY:JUD-484-nonlawyer-preparation).

heading: Injunction to restrain defendant from unlawful practice of the law
review_reason: Injunctions in unauthorized-practice actions brought by the Attorney General or a bar association; an enforcement remedy for others, not a settlement step.

heading: Investigation by the attorney-general
review_reason: Attorney General investigations of unauthorized practice; an enforcement power for the State.

heading: Settlement of actions for personal injury
review_reason: Attorney consent to settlements of personal injury actions; not a claim in the chain.

heading: Practicing or appearing as attorney-at-law without being admitted and registered
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Soliciting business on behalf of an attorney
review_reason: No person may solicit legal business or retainers for an attorney; bars Handoff or a manager from soliciting owners' collection matters or tenants' claims for a law firm.

heading: Entering hospital to negotiate settlement or obtain release or statement
review_reason: Bars entering a hospital to obtain releases from injured patients within 15 days; personal-injury releases only.

heading: Aiding, assisting or abetting the solicitation of persons or the procurement of a retainer for or on behalf of an attorney
review_reason: Bars hospital, police, prison, court and bail-bond personnel from aiding attorney solicitation; none is an actor in the chain.

heading: Employment by attorney of person to aid, assist or abet in the solicitation of business or the procurement through solicitation of a reta...
review_reason: Binds attorneys: an attorney may not employ a person to solicit legal business; the matching bars on Handoff or a manager soliciting for, or being paid for placing claims with, a collection attorney are proposed at NY:JUD-479-no-solicitation and NY:JUD-491-no-fee-sharing, so no further step changes.

heading: Signs advertising services as attorney at law
review_reason: Signs advertising legal services must name the attorney; no settlement step.

heading: None but attorneys to practice in the state
review_reason: The appearance rule bars Handoff and managers from appearing or signing pleadings as attorney; 484 adds that no natural person who is not an attorney may take compensation for preparing pleadings in a court of record (including the NYC Civil Court) or instruments affecting real estate for another, which limits what Handoff's or a manager's staff may draft for a fee.

heading: Violation of certain preceding sections a misdemeanor
review_reason: Makes violations of Judiciary Law 478-484 misdemeanors; the misdemeanor consequence is stated in the appearance rule, and for 484 in its proposed rule (NY:JUD-484-nonlawyer-preparation).

heading: Violation of certain sections a class E felony
review_reason: The appearance rule makes unauthorized practice a misdemeanor; 485-a makes it a class E felony where the person falsely holds itself out as able to provide attorneys' services and causes loss over $1,000.

heading: Practice of law by attorney who has been disbarred, suspended, or convicted of a felony
review_reason: Practice by disbarred or suspended attorneys; it binds such persons, not the landlord or Handoff.

heading: Conviction for felony of person who is an attorney and counselor at law
review_reason: Court clerks report attorneys' felony convictions; outside the chain.

heading: Misconduct by attorneys
review_reason: An attorney who deceives a court or party (for example with a false affidavit of service or amount in a balance suit) is liable to the injured former tenant for treble damages; a risk the owner's choice of collection counsel carries.

heading: Buying demands on which to bring an action
review_reason: A collection attorney may not buy or take assignment of a former tenant's balance to sue on it, nor give value for having claims placed with it; limits how a balance can be handed to a law firm.

heading: Purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Limitation
review_reason: The champerty rule treats an assignment of a balance taken to sue on as void; 490 excepts a claim received in payment for services actually rendered or for a pre-existing debt, which changes whether an owner can assign a balance to Handoff or a vendor in payment of what it owes them.

heading: Sharing of compensation by attorneys prohibited
review_reason: No person or company may receive any part of an attorney's fee or any reward for placing a claim with an attorney for collection or suit; bars Handoff or a manager from taking referral fees or fee splits from the law firm that collects former tenants' balances.

heading: Use of attorney's name by another
review_reason: An attorney who knowingly lets a non-partner prosecute an action in the attorney's name, and the person who uses the name, commit a misdemeanor; the criminal counterpart of Judiciary Law 476.

heading: Attorneys forbidden to defend criminal prosecutions carried on by their partners, or formerly by themselves
review_reason: Attorneys may not defend prosecutions their partners bring; criminal practice, outside the chain.

heading: Attorneys may defend themselves
review_reason: Attorneys may defend themselves notwithstanding 493; outside the chain.

heading: Corporations and voluntary associations not to practice law
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: An organization described in subdivision seven of section four hundred ninety-five of this article shall file with the appellate division...
review_reason: Filing duties of legal-services organizations under Judiciary Law 495(7); outside the chain.

heading: Attorneys fiduciary funds
review_reason: Attorney escrow funds that are nominal or short-term go into an IOLA account whose interest goes to the state fund; a tenant's security deposit held for the tenancy by the landlord's attorney is neither, and GOL 7-103 gives any interest to the tenant, so it cannot sit in IOLA.

heading: Professional referrals
review_reason: Bar association referral immunity and privilege; outside the chain.

heading: Lawyer assistance committees
review_reason: Privilege and immunity for lawyer assistance committees; outside the chain.

heading: Purpose
review_reason: An LLC may be formed for any lawful purpose; owning and leasing units is lawful, so no rule's reach changes.

heading: Powers
review_reason: General powers of an LLC to sue, hold and lease property; the limits that decide whether an owner LLC may sue are stated in NY:LLC-808(a)-foreign-authority and NY:LLC-206-publication-suspension.

heading: Formation
review_reason: Formation of an LLC by filing articles and its separate existence until cancellation; the owner entity's capacity rules (publication, foreign authority) are stated, and formation mechanics add no settlement step.

heading: Limited liability company name
review_reason: 204(c) requires an LLC to do business in its filed name unless it has complied with GBL 130; the consequence of using another name on a lease or letter (no action until the assumed-name certificate is filed) is stated.

heading: Reservation of name
review_reason: Reservation of LLC names at the Department of State; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Affidavits of publication
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Execution of articles or certificates
review_reason: Who signs LLC articles and certificates; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Execution, amendment or cancellation by judicial act
review_reason: Court-ordered execution of LLC certificates when a signer refuses; internal to the LLC.

heading: Filing with the department of state
review_reason: Department of State files LLC instruments on form review only; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Liability for false statement in articles or certificates
review_reason: Liability for false statements in filed LLC articles; not a tenancy settlement matter.

heading: Amendment of articles of organization
review_reason: Amendment of an LLC's articles, required within 90 days of a name change; the LLC Law attaches no suspension or suit bar to a late amendment, and the name the owner must use is governed by the stated GBL 130 rule.

heading: Certificate of change
review_reason: Certificate of change of an LLC's office, process address or registered agent; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Certificate of correction
review_reason: Correction of LLC filings; a filing formality that expressly leaves accrued rights and liabilities unaffected.

heading: Authorization of amendment of articles of organization
review_reason: Member and manager authorization of amendments to LLC articles; internal to the LLC.

heading: Restated articles of organization
review_reason: Restated LLC articles; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Beneficial ownership disclosure
review_reason: Beneficial ownership disclosure by LLCs (marked effective and repealed 2026-01-01); a past-due or delinquent status is a record notation and bars no suit or collection.

heading: Governing law
review_reason: Home-state law governs a foreign LLC's internal affairs and members' liability; the chain claims against the owner LLC itself, and the capacity bar is stated (NY:LLC-808(a)-foreign-authority).

heading: Application for authority
review_reason: A foreign LLC with authority but no proof of publication within 120 days has its authority suspended, the same bar the files state for New York LLCs under 206.

heading: Activities not constituting doing business
review_reason: The capacity bar on a foreign LLC owner is stated with 'doing business' left as a judgment; 803(a) removes from that judgment suing, settling claims, members' meetings and keeping bank accounts. The same exclusions as BCL 1301(b) for corporations.

heading: Amendments to application for authority
review_reason: A foreign LLC amends its application for authority within 90 days of a home-state name change; the section attaches no suspension or suit bar to a late filing, unlike BCL 1309(c) for corporations.

heading: Certificate of change
review_reason: Certificate of change of a foreign LLC's office, process address or registered agent; a filing formality with no settlement step.

heading: Issuance of certificate of authority
review_reason: A foreign LLC is authorized on the Department of State's filing of its application, and authority lasts while it keeps home-state authority and has not surrendered or lost it; the stated rule's pre-suit check is whether that certificate of authority is in force.

heading: Surrender of certificate of authority
review_reason: Surrender of a foreign LLC's authority, with the Secretary of State kept as agent for process on New York causes of action; after surrender a suit on a pre-surrender lease is only the maintaining of an action, which LLC Law 803(a)(1) excludes from doing business (proposed at NY:LLC-803-doing-business-exclusions).

heading: Termination of existence
review_reason: Filing of a foreign LLC's termination and continued service on the Secretary of State; service of the tenant's process, not a settlement step.

heading: Doing business without certificate of authority
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Action by attorney general
review_reason: Attorney General actions to restrain or annul a foreign LLC's authority; State enforcement, not a step for owner, manager or tenant.

heading: Beneficial ownership disclosure
review_reason: Beneficial ownership disclosure by foreign LLCs (marked effective and repealed 2026-01-01); a past-due or delinquent record notation that bars no suit or collection, as the queue decision on LLC Law 215 also records.

heading: Short title
review_reason: Short title of the Multiple Dwelling Law; states no duty, amount or deadline.

heading: Legislative finding
review_reason: Legislative finding for the Multiple Dwelling Law; declares policy, decides nothing.

heading: Application to cities, towns and villages
review_reason: Makes the MDL apply in New York City and lets the city impose and collect liens on rents; the stated MDL rent bars and the HPD rent levy depend on this reach and state its consequences.

heading: Definitions
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: General application of chapter to dwellings
review_reason: Specific-over-general rule for applying MDL requirements by dwelling class; no stated or proposed rule in the chain turns on it (MDL 4(7), 301-302, 325 and 302-a apply by their own terms).

heading: Buildings converted or altered
review_reason: Which MDL standards apply to buildings converted or altered after 1929; the settlement consequence of conversion (certificate of occupancy) is stated by NY:MDL-301(1) and NY:MDL-302(1)(b).

heading: Time for compliance
review_reason: Time for alterations after the MDL was adopted; historical compliance period with no current settlement effect.

heading: Dwellings damaged or moved
review_reason: Rebuilding standards for a multiple dwelling damaged two-thirds or moved; a construction rule, no effect on rent, deposit or the account (casualty surrender runs under RPL 227).

heading: Prohibited uses
review_reason: Prohibited uses of multiple dwellings (prostitution, livestock, combustibles); no settlement amount or date turns on it.

heading: Application of chapter to existing dwellings
review_reason: Application of the MDL to dwellings existing in 1929; the certificate-of-occupancy consequences are stated at NY:MDL-301(1), and this changes no settlement step.

heading: Application of chapter to uncompleted dwellings
review_reason: Application of the MDL to dwellings under construction in 1929; no current tenancy turns on it.

heading: Multiple dwelling emergency information
review_reason: The owner's emergency contact list may be used only for emergency evacuation; using it to reach a departed tenant for the statement, refund or a balance is barred. No rule states this data limit.

heading: Height, bulk, open spaces
review_reason: Height, bulk, yard and court standards for multiple dwellings; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Two or more buildings on same lot
review_reason: Open-space and access rules for two buildings on one lot; construction standard only.

heading: Painting of courts and shafts
review_reason: Painting of courts and shafts; building maintenance with no settlement consequence.

heading: Lighting and ventilation of rooms
review_reason: Light and ventilation of rooms; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Size of rooms
review_reason: Room sizes and sleeping-room occupancy limits; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Alcoves
review_reason: Alcove standards; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Cooking spaces
review_reason: Kitchen and kitchenette standards; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Rooms in basements and cellars
review_reason: Construction and occupancy standards for cellar and basement rooms; whether a unit is lawfully occupied enters the chain through the certificate-of-occupancy rent bar (NY:MDL-301(1), NY:MDL-302(1)(b)) and the city cellar rule (NYC:HMC-27-2087-cellar-basement), which this does not change.

heading: Entrance doors and lights
review_reason: Entrance door glazing and entrance lighting; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Windows and skylights for public halls and stairs
review_reason: Window and skylight dimensions for public halls; construction standard only.

heading: Artificial hall lighting
review_reason: Hall lighting duty in multiple dwellings; it enters no charge, credit or deadline in the settlement.

heading: Entrance halls
review_reason: Entrance hall widths; construction standard only.

heading: Entrances: doors, locks and intercommunication systems
review_reason: Self-locking entrance doors and intercoms; the cost-recovery clause reaches only rent-controlled and redevelopment-company buildings, and a tenant's damage to the equipment is ordinary tenant damage already stated (NY:GOL-7-108(1-a)(b)-refundable).

heading: Rights of tenants to operate and maintain a lobby attendant service
review_reason: Tenants' right to run a lobby attendant service; no settlement charge, credit or deadline turns on it.

heading: Shafts, elevators and dumbwaiters
review_reason: Shaft, elevator and dumbwaiter construction; no charge, deadline or recovery consequence.

heading: Peepholes
review_reason: Peephole duty in multiple dwellings; the owner's installation cost is never a tenant charge and no settlement step turns on it.

heading: Mirrors in connection with self-service elevators
review_reason: Mirrors in self-service elevators; building standard with no settlement consequence.

heading: Rights of tenants to install and maintain locks in certain entrance doors
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Stairs
review_reason: Stair construction and repair; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Fire-escapes
review_reason: Fire-escape construction and maintenance; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Cellar entrance
review_reason: Cellar entrance construction; construction standard only.

heading: Wainscoting
review_reason: Wainscoting backing in multiple dwellings; building standard with no settlement consequence.

heading: Frame buildings and extensions
review_reason: Frame building and extension limits, store-to-dwelling conversion approvals; construction standard only.

heading: Bells
review_reason: Doorbells kept working and mail delivery arranged; building service with no settlement consequence.

heading: Incombustible materials
review_reason: Fire-test standard for incombustible materials; construction standard only.

heading: Bakeries and fat boiling
review_reason: Bakeries and fat boiling in multiple dwellings; building standard with no settlement consequence.

heading: Motor vehicle storage
review_reason: Garage and parking construction in multiple dwellings; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Business uses
review_reason: Business uses in multiple dwellings (egress, fire-retarding); governs non-residential space, not the tenancy account.

heading: Parapets, guard railings and wires
review_reason: Parapets, guard rails and roof wires; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Sub-curb uses
review_reason: Fireproofing and egress for sub-curb living rooms; construction standard only.

heading: Lighting
review_reason: Lighting fixtures, gas meters and appliance venting; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Boiler rooms
review_reason: Boiler room enclosure; construction standard only.

heading: Lodging houses
review_reason: Fire-safety and occupancy standards for lodging houses (class B dwellings); a lodging house is not a market-rate apartment tenancy.

heading: Hotels and certain other class A and class B dwellings
review_reason: Fire-safety standards for hotels and class A and B dwellings, and the bar on transient (under 30-day) use of class A units; the transient-use bar governs short-term rentals, not the settlement of a departing market-rate tenancy.

heading: Smoke detecting devices
review_reason: MDL 68(7) makes the section inapplicable in cities of one million or more; NYC detectors are governed by the Housing Maintenance Code (NYC:HMC-27-2045-detector-charge) (outside NYC).

heading: Water supply
review_reason: Owner's duty to supply water (hot and cold); a failure enters the settlement only through the habitability offset (NY:RPL-235-b) and the stays for dangerous conditions, which state that consequence.

heading: Water-closet and bath accommodations
review_reason: Water-closet and bath accommodations by class of dwelling; building standards with no settlement consequence.

heading: Plumbing and drainage
review_reason: Plumbing and drainage duties; the owner's repair duty and its allocation are stated by MDL 78 (proposed NY:MDL-78-repair-allocation) and habitability (NY:RPL-235-b).

heading: Repairs
review_reason: Deposit deductions for tenant-caused damage are stated (NY:GOL-7-108(1-a)(b)-refundable); MDL 78 allocates repair in a multiple dwelling: the owner keeps it in repair, and the tenant is liable only for conditions caused by its own wilful act or negligence or that of its household or guests.

heading: Heating
review_reason: Heat standards for multiple dwellings; a heat failure enters the settlement only through the habitability offset (NY:RPL-235-b), which states that consequence.

heading: Cleanliness
review_reason: The owner's cleaning, vermin and repainting duties and their move-out allocation (owner's cost unless the tenant, its household or guests caused the condition) are stated by the painting, turnover and wear-and-tear rules.

heading: Receptacles for waste matter
review_reason: Waste receptacles and removal duty; it fixes no settlement charge or credit.

heading: Privacy
review_reason: Room layout requirement for privacy in class A apartments; building standard with no settlement consequence.

heading: Janitor or housekeeper
review_reason: Resident janitor for buildings of thirteen or more families; no settlement consequence.

heading: Construction standards for the control of noise
review_reason: Sound-transmission construction standards; building standard with no settlement consequence.

heading: Definitions
review_reason: Definitions for MDL art. 7-D (inhabited basement and cellar units in listed community districts); the article's operative sections (289, 290) were decided no_decision in the queue and no stated or proposed rule depends on these terms.

heading: Basement and cellar local laws and regulations
review_reason: Enabling authority for NYC's basement and cellar legalization pilot; any effect on a tenancy comes from the local law adopted under it, in the NYC layer (NYC:HMC-27-2087-cellar-basement).

heading: Tenant protections in inhabited basement dwelling units and inhabited cellar dwelling units
review_reason: Basement and cellar legalization program: certification and a right of first refusal to return after legalization; it fixes nothing in a market-rate move-out settlement.

heading: Permits
review_reason: Building permits for construction, alteration and conversion, and the cellar/basement occupancy permit; rent recovery for unlawful occupancy runs through MDL 301-302 and the cellar rule NYC:HMC-27-2087, already stated; the permit procedure itself changes no settlement step.

heading: Certificate of compliance or occupancy
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Unlawful occupation
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Abatement of rent in the case of serious violations
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Removal of violations by mortgagees
reason: UNIVERSE: cited by an independent review universe item (U5A-074)
review_reason: A foreclosing mortgagee's advances to a receiver for repairs; mortgage and receivership finance, not the tenant's account.

heading: Right of tenant to offset payments for heat failure
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Enforcement
review_reason: HPD enforces the MDL; no settlement amount or payee turns on it.

heading: Penalties for violations
review_reason: Criminal and civil penalties payable to the city for MDL violations; the rent consequences of those violations are stated separately (NY:MDL-302(1)(b), NY:MDL-302-a(3), NY:MDL-325(2)) and these penalties change no settlement amount.

heading: Violation of local laws and regulations
review_reason: Misdemeanor for builders knowingly violating local construction laws; not a settlement matter.

heading: Judicial procedure and orders
review_reason: The city's enforcement actions and orders under the MDL; no settlement amount or payee turns on them.

heading: Liens
review_reason: Lien for MDL fines owed to the city; no settlement amount or payee turns on it.

heading: Notice of pendency of action
review_reason: Notice of pendency in the city's MDL enforcement actions; no settlement step turns on it.

heading: Repairs, vacation and demolition of buildings
review_reason: The city layer's HPD receiver and rent levy are stated; MDL 309 is the state source for the same payee shifts: a nuisance receiver collects accrued and accruing rents, and after the department serves an expense order or judgment and demands it in writing, rent is paid to the department and its receipt counts as payment to the owner.

heading: Multiple dwelling
review_reason: Bars building staff from living in units that may not lawfully be rented; not a settlement matter.

heading: Board of appeals
review_reason: Board of Standards and Appeals variance powers; administrative, no effect on the account.

heading: Registry of owner, agent and lessee
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Service of notices, orders and summonses
review_reason: The rent-impairing violation bar runs from notice to the owner (NY:MDL-302-a(3)); 326 decides when that notice is validly served, by posting plus mailing to the registered address.

heading: Indexing names
review_reason: HPD indexes MDL 325 registrations as public records; the registration consequence is stated (NY:MDL-325(2)).

heading: Central Violations Bureau
review_reason: The rent bars for rent-impairing violations and non-registration are stated; 328(3) decides how they are proved in the Housing Part: HPD's computerized violation and registration files are prima facie evidence and judicially noticed.

heading: Certificate of inspection visits
review_reason: HPD certificate of inspection visits posted in the building; no settlement consequence.

heading: Legislative findings and purpose
review_reason: Legislative findings for the article 81 guardianship system; the operative guardian powers are in 81.21, 81.29 and related sections decided in the queue.

heading: Power to appoint a guardian of the person and/or property
review_reason: Standard for appointing a guardian; the landlord relies on the order, not the standard.

heading: Definitions
review_reason: Article 81 definitions (guardian, property management); the proposed guardian rules (NY:MHL-81.21-guardian-property-powers, 81.27, 81.29) already take an article 81 guardian with property-management powers as their condition, so these terms do not change their reach.

heading: Jurisdiction
review_reason: Which courts may appoint a guardian; guardianship jurisdiction.

heading: Venue
review_reason: Venue of a guardianship proceeding.

heading: Who may commence a proceeding
review_reason: Who may petition for a guardian; the landlord's decisions follow the appointment, not the petition.

heading: Notice
review_reason: Commencement, order to show cause and service in a guardianship proceeding; the landlord is not a party and nothing in the account turns on it.

heading: Petition
review_reason: Contents of a guardianship petition.

heading: Appointment of court evaluator
review_reason: Appointment and duties of the court evaluator.

heading: Counsel
review_reason: Counsel for the alleged incapacitated person and its compensation; no effect on the statement, refund or a balance.

heading: Hearing
review_reason: Hearing procedure in a guardianship proceeding.

heading: Burden and quantum of proof
review_reason: Burden of proof in a guardianship proceeding; the landlord relies on the appointment order, not on the finding's proof.

heading: Timing of hearing
review_reason: Hearing preference, decision within 7 days and commission within 15 days; the landlord acts only on an issued commission (proposed NY:MHL-81.27-commission), so the court's timing changes nothing it does.

heading: Record of the proceedings
review_reason: Record and sealing of guardianship proceedings; no duty on the landlord or collector.

heading: Findings
review_reason: Findings the court makes when appointing; the powers that result are read from the commission (proposed NY:MHL-81.27-commission).

heading: Dispositional alternatives
review_reason: A court may, without a guardian, authorize or ratify a single transaction for an incapacitated tenant through a special guardian, who is then the party the landlord deals with for it.

heading: Nomination of guardian
review_reason: Nomination of a guardian by the alleged incapacitated person; the landlord deals only with the appointed guardian.

heading: Foreign guardian for a person not present in the state
review_reason: A foreign guardian may be appointed a New York guardian; until then, payment to a foreign fiduciary of a non-domiciliary incompetent is governed by EPTL 13-3.4 (proposed NY:EPTL-13-3.4-foreign-fiduciary).

heading: Eligibility as guardian
review_reason: Who may serve as guardian.

heading: Duties of guardian
review_reason: The guardian's own duties to the incapacitated person (care, reports, visits, delivery of property); they bind the guardian, not the landlord.

heading: Powers of guardian
review_reason: Decides who receives the statement and refund, who may settle or pay the balance, and who is sued, when the tenant has a property-management guardian; no rule covers an incapacitated tenant beyond CPLR 1203 defaults.

heading: Powers of guardian
review_reason: Personal-needs powers (care, abode, medical decisions); a guardian with only these powers does not receive the refund or settle the account, which stays with the tenant (proposed NY:MHL-81.29-retained-rights).

heading: Provisional remedies
review_reason: A temporary guardian may be the payee or party for a tenant during a pending proceeding, and an injunction may bar anyone from taking property or a confession of judgment from the tenant.

heading: Notice of pendency
review_reason: The petitioner files a notice of pendency when the proceeding affects real property; a tenant's leasehold settlement is not affected.

heading: Filing of bond by guardian
review_reason: Guardian's bond.

heading: Designation of clerk to receive process
review_reason: Guardian designates the clerk to receive process; folded into the service note of proposed NY:MHL-81.27-commission, it changes no settlement step itself.

heading: Commission to guardian
review_reason: The commission is the document that shows a guardian's specific powers and end date; dealing with a guardian outside it does not bind the tenant.

heading: Compensation of guardian
review_reason: Court plan for the guardian's compensation; paid from the ward's estate under court order, not a landlord or account matter.

heading: Effect of the appointment on the incapacitated person
review_reason: Decides that an incapacitated tenant keeps every right not granted to the guardian, and that a court may revoke contracts the tenant made while incapacitated (a lease, move-out agreement or release).

heading: Initial report
review_reason: Guardian's initial report and inventory to the court; a duty between guardian and court, none on the landlord.

heading: Annual report
review_reason: Guardian's annual report; a duty between guardian and court, none on the landlord.

heading: Examination of initial and annual reports
review_reason: Court examination of guardian reports; no landlord duty.

heading: Intermediate and final report
review_reason: Guardian's intermediate and final reports to the court.

heading: Decree on filing instruments approving accounts
review_reason: Court decree approving a guardian's accounts.

heading: Removal of guardian
review_reason: Removal of a guardian; the consequence for whom the landlord pays after a removal is in the proposed NY:MHL-81.38-interim-standby, and removal procedure itself adds nothing.

heading: Discharge or modification of powers of guardian
review_reason: Discharge or modification of a guardian's powers; the powers in force at the time are read from the current commission or order (proposed NY:MHL-81.27-commission).

heading: Resignation or suspension of powers of guardian
review_reason: Resignation or suspension of a guardian; who then acts is proposed at MHL 81.38.

heading: Vacancy in office
review_reason: Decides who acts for an incapacitated tenant when the guardian dies, resigns or is removed mid-settlement: an interim or standby guardian.

heading: Guardian education requirements
review_reason: Guardian training requirements; no effect on the account.

heading: Court evaluator education requirements
review_reason: Court evaluator training requirements; no effect on the account.

heading: Court examiner education requirements
review_reason: Court examiner training requirements; no effect on the account.

heading: Compliance
review_reason: Technical defects do not defeat a guardianship proceeding, and an order releases the guardian and sureties; no landlord step changes.

heading: Proceedings to discover property withheld
review_reason: A guardian's turnover proceeding to discover withheld property; a forum for the tenant's existing deposit claim that changes nothing the landlord owes or must send.

heading: Proceedings upon the death of an incapacitated person
review_reason: Adds that when a tenant under guardianship dies, the guardian stops being the payee and delivers to the personal representative or public administrator.

heading: Findings and declaration of emergency
review_reason: Legislative findings for article 13.

heading: Definitions
reason: DEFINITIONS: definition section in a unit that has a stated rule
review_reason: The state article 13 rules depend on this definition, and it reaches New York state active duty and national guard state duty that the federal SCRA does not, so it widens who gets the state protections.

heading: Notice of benefits to persons in and persons enlisting in the state organized militia
review_reason: Adjutant general's duty to publicize militia benefits; no duty on a landlord or collector.

heading: Extension of benefits to dependents
review_reason: Extends the article 13 protections the files apply to the servicemember tenant (310 termination, 323-a 6% cap, stays) to dependents, and obliges the landlord to grant them on the dependent's direct application.

heading: Accident prevention course information
review_reason: Division of military affairs to provide accident-prevention course information; unrelated to tenancy.

heading: Stay, et cetera, to persons secondarily liable
review_reason: NY:MIL-306-309 states the stay for the servicemember; 302 adds that a guarantor or co-obligor may be stayed too, and limits a guarantor's waiver.

heading: Representation
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Proceedings to be stayed unless interest unaffected by military service
review_reason: NY:MIL-306-309 says a suit may be stayed; 304 makes the stay mandatory on the servicemember's application unless its ability to defend is not materially affected.

heading: Relief against fines and penalties, et cetera
review_reason: Stops late fees and other contract penalties accruing during a military stay and lets a court relieve penalties incurred during service; changes what may be charged.

heading: Actions against persons in service
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Continuance of stay, et cetera
review_reason: Adds the stay's maximum length, installment terms and the right to proceed against co-defendants by leave.

heading: Statutes of limitations and statutes of a similar nature
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Waiver of professional continuing education requirements
review_reason: Waiver of professional continuing education during service; licensing, not tenancy.

heading: Extension of license, certificate or registration
review_reason: Extension of professional licences during active duty; licensing, not tenancy.

heading: Evictions
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Liability for rent accruing after induction
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Installment purchases
review_reason: Protects servicemembers under contracts to buy real or personal property, or leases with a view to purchase; a residential lease is not such a contract (dwelling leases: NY:MIL-310(2), NY:MIL-306-309).

heading: Termination of motor vehicle lease contracts
review_reason: Termination of motor vehicle leases by servicemembers; not a residential lease.

heading: Cancellation without penalty of certain additional rental contracts
review_reason: Covers rental contracts for goods or services not otherwise addressed by article 13; a dwelling lease is addressed by Military Law 310 (NY:MIL-310(2)).

heading: Termination without penalty of certain service contracts
review_reason: Termination of telecom, internet, health club and TV contracts; not a residential lease.

heading: Mortgages
review_reason: Stays enforcement of mortgages on property a servicemember owns; the tenant's lease balance is not a mortgage obligation.

heading: Settlement of cases involving stayed proceeding in foreclosure or repossession of personal property
review_reason: Appraisal and settlement in stayed foreclosure or repossession of personal property; not a lease balance.

heading: Exercise of rights under this article not to affect certain future financial transactions
review_reason: Bars basing an adverse credit report on the servicemember's having sought or obtained article 13 relief; changes what the landlord may report.

heading: Taxes
review_reason: Property-tax sales and interest on a servicemember's own property; not part of a tenancy settlement.

heading: Taxes
review_reason: Deferral of state income tax for servicemembers; not part of a tenancy settlement.

heading: Policies of insurance
review_reason: Life insurance policies of servicemembers do not lapse; not a tenancy matter.

heading: Protection of assignor of life insurance policy
review_reason: The federal rule states the court-order requirement for SCRA servicemembers; subdivision 2 extends it to New York state active duty and fixes a three-month tail and a return notice. Subdivision 1 (life-insurance assignments) changes nothing.

heading: Professional liability protection for certain persons ordered to active duty in armed forces
review_reason: Suspension of professional liability insurance during active duty; not a tenancy matter.

heading: Reemployment in private industry
review_reason: Reemployment rights of servicemembers; employment law.

heading: Policy of the state
review_reason: The federal rule limits waivers of SCRA rights; 318 forbids even asking a New York servicemember to waive article 13 rights, voids the waiver and sets criminal and civil penalties.

heading: Evasive transfers of interest
review_reason: Lets a court disregard transfers made to exploit article 13; a court remedy that changes no landlord step or amount.

heading: Certificates of service
review_reason: Evidence rules for proving military service (certificates, missing persons) in article 13 proceedings; the service status the rules depend on is a fact input, and the notice with orders the landlord relies on is stated in NY:MIL-310(2) and NY:MIL-323-a-6pct.

heading: Interlocutory orders
review_reason: Courts may revoke or modify their interlocutory article 13 orders; court procedure.

heading: Further relief
review_reason: Lets a servicemember obtain a court-ordered stay and installment schedule on a pre-service lease balance, with no penalties accruing; changes when and how the balance may be collected.

heading: Maximum rate of interest
reason: at least one rule-file atom cites this section (provision or source_file)
review_reason: Stated by the rules that cite it (register step 3 citation match); those rules passed independent review rounds 1-5.

heading: Filing fees waiver
review_reason: Waives court filing fees for militia members suing over their service; changes nothing the landlord owes or does.

heading: Separability
review_reason: Severability clause.

heading: Inconsistent provisions in other acts
review_reason: Article 13 controls over inconsistent laws; the article's rules are stated to apply on their own terms, and no conflict with the deposit or collection rules changes a step.

heading: Article thirteen of military law, added by laws of nineteen hundred forty-one, chapter six hundred eighty-six
review_reason: Saving clause for rights based on service before 1948-04-01; no current tenancy is affected.

heading: Duration of the emergency
review_reason: Article 13 stays in force until repealed, which is why its rules carry no end date; nothing else changes.

heading: Short title
review_reason: Short title of Military Law article 13; decides nothing.

heading: Authorization of foreign corporations
review_reason: Requires a foreign not-for-profit to be authorized before conducting activities and lists acts that are not conducting activities (suing, settling, bank accounts); an owner leasing NYC units conducts activities under any reading, so the list does not change the reach of the proposed NY:NPCL-1313-foreign-authority bar.

heading: Application to existing authorized foreign corporations
review_reason: Transition rule continuing pre-1970 certificates of authority; no effect on a current owner's capacity beyond having authority, which the 1313 bar already tests.

heading: Violations
review_reason: Attorney General actions to restrain or annul a foreign not-for-profit's authority; an owner whose authority is annulled is simply without authority, which the proposed NY:NPCL-1313-foreign-authority already covers.

heading: Application for authority
review_reason: Contents of an application for authority; a filing form, the capacity consequence sits in 1313.

heading: Application for authority
review_reason: Effect of filing the application: authority continues while the corporation keeps its home-state authority; capacity is tested under the proposed 1313 bar by whether authority exists, with nothing further for the account.

heading: Powers of authorized foreign corporations
review_reason: Powers of an authorized foreign not-for-profit; no effect on the account.

heading: Tenure of real property
review_reason: Foreign not-for-profit may hold and convey real property; ownership of the building is a Step 0 fact already assumed, no settlement rule turns on it.

heading: Amendments or changes
review_reason: Permitted amendments to an application for authority; filing mechanics only (the name-change suspension is in 1309(b)).

heading: Certificate of amendment
review_reason: 1309(b) suspends a foreign not-for-profit owner's authority twenty days after an unfiled name change, which bars it from suing a former tenant until cured; the 120-day retroactive cure is not in any rule.

heading: Certificate of change
review_reason: Certificate of change of office, process address or registered agent; filing mechanics, no suspension or capacity consequence.

heading: Surrender of authority
review_reason: Surrender of authority and service on the Secretary of State for earlier liabilities; affects where a tenant serves process, not what the landlord does, owes or recovers.

heading: Termination of existence
review_reason: Filing of a foreign not-for-profit corporation's termination and continued service on the Secretary of State; affects service of the tenant's process, not a settlement step.

heading: Actions or special proceedings by unauthorized foreign corporations
review_reason: The BCL rule covers business corporations; a foreign not-for-profit corporation owner is under the parallel N-PCL bar, which also requires paying back fees and taxes and binds successors.

heading: Actions or special proceedings by foreign corporations
review_reason: A foreign not-for-profit corporation sues like a domestic one except as statute prescribes; the statutory bar is proposed at N-PCL 1313.

heading: Actions or special proceedings against foreign corporations
review_reason: When non-residents may sue a foreign not-for-profit corporation; a former tenant's claim on an NYC lease qualifies, so nothing changes.

heading: Record of members
review_reason: Members' right to inspect a foreign not-for-profit's member records; internal governance.

heading: Voting trust records
review_reason: Voting trust records of a foreign corporation; internal governance.

heading: Liabilities of directors and officers of foreign corporations
review_reason: Directors' and officers' liability under N-PCL 719-720 applied to foreign not-for-profits; runs to the corporation and its members, not to tenants or the account.

heading: Liability of foreign corporations for failure to disclose required information
review_reason: Foreign not-for-profit's disclosure duty to its members; internal governance.

heading: Applicability of other provisions
review_reason: Lists internal-governance provisions (derivative suits, indemnification, mergers) applied to foreign not-for-profits.

heading: Exemption from certain provisions
review_reason: Exemption of certain foreign not-for-profits from 1317(e), 1318(a)(1) and 1320(a)(2); internal governance.

heading: Definitions
review_reason: Definitions for the Revised Limited Partnership Act (publication affidavits, partner, foreign LP); the queue's proposed LP capacity rules (121-902, 121-907, 121-104-A) take 'foreign limited partnership' in its ordinary sense and these terms do not narrow or widen them.

heading: Partnership name
review_reason: Name requirements for a limited partnership; its only conduct rule, using the certificate name unless GBL 130 is complied with, has its suit consequence stated in NY:GBL-130-assumed-name.

heading: Reservation of partnership name
review_reason: Reservation of a limited partnership name; filing mechanics.

heading: Statutory designation of secretary of state as agent for service of process
review_reason: Secretary of State as the partnership's agent for process; affects service of a tenant's suit on the owner, not what the landlord does, owes or recovers (the address-resignation suspension is proposed under 121-104-A).

heading: Resignation for receipt of process
review_reason: A limited partnership whose process address resigned and was not replaced has its authority suspended, which bars it from suing a former tenant until it files a new address.

heading: Registered agent
review_reason: Designation and resignation of a registered agent; unlike 121-104-A it carries no suspension, so capacity to sue is unaffected.

heading: Records
review_reason: Records a limited partnership keeps for its partners; internal governance.

heading: Nature of business
review_reason: A limited partnership may carry on any lawful business; no settlement rule turns on it.

heading: Business transactions of partner with the partnership
review_reason: Partner may transact business with the partnership; internal.

heading: Service of process on limited partnerships
review_reason: How process is served on a limited partnership through the Secretary of State; service on the owner is the tenant's step, and the landlord's own capacity rules are proposed at 121-907 and 121-902.

heading: Electronic service of process
review_reason: Optional electronic service of process on partnerships; service mechanics.

heading: The partnership agreement
review_reason: Written partnership agreement and its amendment; internal governance.

heading: Certificate of limited partnership
review_reason: A domestic limited partnership that has not filed proof of publication has its authority suspended and cannot sue a former tenant until it files; the queue proposed the foreign-LP and LLP versions but no rule covers the domestic LP.

heading: Amendment of the certificate of limited partnership
review_reason: Amendments to the certificate of limited partnership on changes of partners, name or process address; no suspension or settlement consequence attaches.

heading: Certificate of change
review_reason: Certificate of change of office, process address or agent; filing mechanics.

heading: Cancellation of certificate
review_reason: Certificate of cancellation after dissolution; winding-up capacity is governed by 121-803, and cancellation itself changes nothing in the account.

heading: Execution of certificates
review_reason: Who signs limited partnership certificates; filing mechanics.

heading: Execution, amendment or cancellation by judicial act
review_reason: Court-ordered execution of certificates at a partner's petition; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Filing with the department of state
review_reason: Filing of certificates with the Department of State; filing mechanics.

heading: Liability for false statement in certificate
review_reason: Liability for materially false statements in a filed certificate to one who relied on it; a tenant does not deal in reliance on the partnership certificate, and nothing in the settlement turns on it.

heading: Restated certificate of limited partnership
review_reason: Restated certificate of limited partnership; filing mechanics.

heading: Admission of limited partners
review_reason: Admission of limited partners; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Classes and voting by limited partners
review_reason: Classes and voting of limited partners; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Liability to third parties
review_reason: Limited partners' liability for the partnership's debts; the landlord of record (the partnership) owes the refund and damages, and whether a tenant can reach a limited partner personally is enforcement against the owner's principals, not a step any actor takes in the settlement (consistent with the queue's 121-1001 decision).

heading: Person erroneously believing himself a limited partner
review_reason: Person erroneously believing himself a limited partner; liability to creditors who extended credit in reliance, not a settlement step.

heading: Admission of additional general partners
review_reason: Admission of additional general partners; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Events of withdrawal of a general partner
review_reason: Events that end a general partner's status (withdrawal, bankruptcy, death); changes who manages the owner partnership, not the partnership's rights or duties toward the tenant.

heading: General powers and liabilities
review_reason: General partners carry a general partner's powers and liabilities; the partnership remains the landlord that owes and collects, and reaching a general partner personally is enforcement against the owner's principals outside the settlement steps.

heading: Contributions by a general partner
review_reason: General partner contributions and profit sharing; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Classes and voting by general partners
review_reason: Classes and voting of general partners; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Form of contribution
review_reason: Form of partner contributions; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Liability for contributions
review_reason: Partner contribution obligations and compromise; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Sharing of profits and losses
review_reason: Allocation of profits and losses; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Sharing of distributions
review_reason: Allocation of distributions; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Interim distributions
review_reason: Interim distributions to partners; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Withdrawal of a general partner
review_reason: Withdrawal of a general partner; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.

heading: Withdrawal of a limited partner
review_reason: Withdrawal of a limited partner; internal partnership governance; no effect on the tenancy account.
